import json
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

root = Path('train/data_dagger_qwen35')
collection = json.loads((root / 'collection.json').read_text())
raw = root / 'on_policy.jsonl'
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in raw.read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(rows) == 300
assert len({(r['game'], r['seed']) for r in rows}) == 300
assert all(len(r['examples']) == 6 for r in rows)
for game in ('dice', 'cards'):
    assert sorted(r['seed'] for r in rows if r['game'] == game) == list(range(30000, 30150))
assert len({r['provenance']['adapter_sha256'] for r in rows}) == 1
assert collection['on_policy_states'] == 1800 and collection['original_states'] == 4000
assert collection['data_sha256'] == file_sha256(root / 'train.jsonl')
audit_path = Path('results/training/qwen35_dagger_token_audit.json')
audit = json.loads(audit_path.read_text())
assert all(not split['prefix_mismatch_rows'] and split['max_tokens'] <= 1025 for split in audit['splits'].values())
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'verify completed registered DAgger collection'}, collection['model_revision']),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'collection': collection,
          'episodes_by_game': dict(Counter(r['game'] for r in rows)),
          'states_by_game': {g: sum(len(r['examples']) for r in rows if r['game'] == g) for g in ('dice', 'cards')},
          'input_sha256': {str(p): file_sha256(p) for p in (raw, root/'train.jsonl', root/'valid.jsonl', root/'collection.json', audit_path)},
          'token_audit': audit, 'status': 'collection_complete_training_started',
          'interpretation': 'Training states only. No held-out or policy-validation score; greedy actor and exact teacher use the frozen completed SFT adapter.'}
Path('results/training/qwen35_dagger_collection.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k: record[k] for k in ('episodes_by_game', 'states_by_game', 'status')}))
